meribah_783.why: Moses named it Meribah because the people of Israel quarreled and tested the Lord there (Exodus 17).

moriah_821.meaning: Possibly the Lord sees or provides

most_holy_place_826.meaning: Holy of holies, the holiest place

mount_moriah_848.meaning: Possibly the Lord sees or provides

mount_nebo_849.meaning: Possibly named for the god Nabu

peniel_930.why: Jacob named it Peniel because he had seen God face to face and his life was spared (Genesis 32).

perez-uzzah_935.why: David named it Perez-uzzah because the Lord had broken out against Uzzah there (2 Samuel 6).

plain_of_jordan_654.meaning: Plain or circle of the Jordan

sea_of_tiberias_1034.meaning: Named for the city of Tiberias, honoring Emperor Tiberius

sela-hammahlekoth_1297.meaning: Rock of escape, or of parting
sela-hammahlekoth_1297.why: Saul turned back from chasing David to meet the Philistines, so it was called the Rock of Escape (1 Samuel 23).

taberah_1127.why: It was called Taberah because the fire of the Lord burned among the people there (Numbers 11).

tel-abib_1143.meaning: Possibly mound of the flood, or hill of grain

valley_of_beracah_1200.why: Judah blessed the Lord there after his victory, so it was named the Valley of Beracah (2 Chronicles 20).

valley_of_hamongog_1205.why: Gog and all his multitude will be buried there, so it will be called Hamon-gog (Ezekiel 39).

valley_of_slaughter_1219.why: God said the valley would be renamed because so many would be slaughtered and buried there in judgment (Jeremiah 7).
